name: gizza-ai/xpath-query
summary: Evaluate an XPath 1.0 expression against XML or XHTML

tool.description: Evaluate an XPath 1.0 expression against an XML or XHTML document and return the matching nodes or values, using a pure-Rust engine (sxd-xpath). Supports location paths (//book/title), attributes (//a/@href), predicates and filters (//book[price < 10]), axes (ancestor/following-sibling/…), and the XPath function library (count(), name(), text(), contains(), substring(), …). A node-set query returns one result per matched node (in document order) — set output='value' for each node's text content or output='xml' for its serialized outer XML. A scalar expression (count(//x), name(/*), //a > 1) returns a single value. Example: '//book[@category="fiction"]/title'.

output.description: What to return for each matched node: 'value' = its string value (text content), 'xml' = its serialized outer XML. Default 'value'.

xml.description: The XML or XHTML document to query.
